value.title: Phase 1: Foundations — workspace, DI architecture, drift enforcement, exemplars

sections.name: summary
sections.value: The whole plan in one phase: scaffold the workspace, land workshop-001's architecture as code, enforce it mechanically, leave one exemplar of everything. Task order is dependency order; every Done-When is a command that passes.

value.title: Workspace scaffold: root Cargo.toml + 7 crates compiling - package names fs3-core, fs3-parsers, fs3-providers, fs3-store, fs3-testkit, fs3-daemon, fs3-cli (dir names core/, parsers/, ...; `core` itself is a reserved cargo name); fs3-cli's [[bin]] is named flowspace3
core: domain types (Element, ElementKind, BlobRef) + pure fns incl. classify with declaration-shape gate + needs_summary; exemplar unit tests
core: Embedder + Summarizer port traits (#[async_trait], dyn-safe, Send+Sync)
testkit: FakeEmbedder (deterministic hash vectors, call recording, failure injection) + FakeSummarizer + generic embedder_contract harness
providers: OpenAI-shaped stub implementing both ports behind a config enum (compiles; real calls #[ignore]d)
parsers: tree-sitter direct with rust + markdown grammars; parse-to-elements exemplar + fixture test (POC learnings: structure gate, bare-kind table)
compose: docker-compose.yml with Postgres+pgvector; documented up/down commands
store: sqlx setup + migration 0001 (minimal exemplar table) + integration test vs compose PG

config: types + serde derives in fs3-core (pure, no IO); file discovery/parsing of ~/.config/flowspace3 (TOML) with FS3_CONFIG_DIR override in fs3-daemon; fs3-cli reads only the daemon URL via the same core types; provider selection incl. fake
daemon: axum skeleton, AppState, composition root (config match incl. fake), GET /health on localhost
cli: flowspace3 binary, HTTP client, flowspace3 ping; fail-fast message naming doctor when daemon absent
drift check: per-crate dependency allow-list script/config wired as a check; negative verification
harness extensions: checks ext = fmt --check + clippy -D warnings + cargo test + drift check; boot ext = toolchain + build + compose probe
docs: README quick-start + docs/how/architecture.md (from workshop 001) signposted from README

tk-0001.assertion: cargo build --workspace green from clean checkout

tk-0002.assertion: cargo test -p fs3-core green; zero test doubles anywhere in core tests; classify rejects a non-declaration node in a test (PRD req 42 exemplar)

tk-0003.assertion: Arc<dyn Embedder> compiles in a doc-test or unit test proving object safety

tk-0004.assertion: contract test green over FakeEmbedder; determinism asserted: same text -> same vector twice

tk-0005.assertion: cargo build -p providers green; #[ignore]d contract test exists for the real impl

tk-0006.assertion: fixture test green: known .rs and .md files yield expected element tables

tk-0007.assertion: docker compose up -d then pg_isready succeeds; documented in README

tk-0008.assertion: integration test connects, migrates, round-trips a row; test names the exact compose command when docker is absent

tk-0009.assertion: unit test: temp config dir with provider=fake parses and selects the fake arm

tk-000a.assertion: integration test: boot with fake config, GET /health returns 200 {status:ok}

tk-000b.assertion: ping against running daemon prints healthy; against no daemon exits non-zero with the doctor suggestion

tk-000c.assertion: check green on the real graph; a committed fixture manifest with a forbidden edge (e.g. sqlx in fs3-core) is asserted RED by a normal cargo test - the negative proof is re-runnable, not a one-shot violate-and-revert

tk-000d.assertion: harness checks green; harness boot healthy (degraded state resolved)

tk-000e.assertion: both files exist; README links the guide; quick-start commands verified by following them
